capabilities.text: Square's Bookings API has an UpdateBooking endpoint for changing a booking after it is created
Square Bookings API can search availability by service, team member, and location
Square's Bookings API can retrieve an existing booking by its ID
Square Bookings API supports booking.created and booking.updated webhooks

faqs.a: Prestique builds the agent to work with Square Appointments rather than replace it. You keep the software you already use. The agent connects to Square Appointments's Bookings API so it works from the same information your team sees.
faqs.q: Will it work with the Square Appointments setup I already have?

faqs.a: It can search availability by service, team member, and location. The returned availability can be turned into a booking by adding a customer. After a booking is created, it can call the UpdateBooking endpoint to make certain changes. It can also retrieve an existing booking by its ID. The agent only does what Square Appointments's API allows and what you have approved it to do.
faqs.q: What can the agent actually do inside Square Appointments?

faqs.a: Anything the agent shouldn't handle goes to your team with a summary of the call. Every call is also recorded with a transcript and a summary of what the caller needed.
faqs.q: What happens when a caller asks for something the agent can't handle?

faqs.a: You control what the agent says and does, and changes are made when you ask for them. Booking follows your own rules, such as your hours, your capacity, and what the agent won't do.
faqs.q: How much control do I have over what the agent says and does?

intro: When your team can't get to the phone — after hours or when the line is busy — the agent answers. It can search availability by service, team member, and location in Square Appointments, and the returned availability can be turned into a booking by adding a customer. Booking follows your own rules, such as your hours, your capacity, and what the agent won't do.
